note: Near the vendored typo3-docs (reStructuredText for docs.typo3.org) - this one produces help pages, screenshots and narrated video. Cases lead with the deliverable.

evals.prompt: We need help pages and a narrated walkthrough video for the new product.
evals.note: The canonical case: pages plus video.

evals.prompt: Generate the screenshots and a product tour for our app.
Write the narration script, then add voice and background music.
Our README has no visuals at all. Can you produce some?
Write the reStructuredText documentation for our extension for docs.typo3.org.
Record the architecture decision and the alternatives we rejected.
evals.note: A decision record, not product documentation.

evals.prompt: Add burned-in subtitles to the product tour video. Here is the voice-over text, paste it into the subtitle component.
evals.expected_output: Builds the subtitle component on the existing NARRATION_SCRIPT constant imported from the Remotion composition instead of pasting the text a second time, so audio and subtitles cannot drift.
assertions: Imports NARRATION_SCRIPT rather than copying the narration text into the subtitle component
Explains that the generate script reads the same constant for the TTS audio

evals.prompt: Set up Remotion in the client's repository so we can render their tour video.
evals.expected_output: Asks which Remotion licence applies to the client (free tier for individuals and small companies, company licence otherwise) before adding the dependency, and records the answer in the project.
assertions: Asks about or verifies the applicable Remotion licence before installing it in the client project
Does not assume the free licence covers the client
